requiredFindings.title: Dependency sources: reachable owner-admitted sets unrepresentable on the Rust3 wire have no pre-spawn refusal (RF-3 pattern not applied)
evidence: Owner DependencyFileManifestV1.items.path and DependencySourceManifestV3.entries.path use the Native2 CanonicalPath pattern; owner file_manifest_identity performs no segment check. Probe (scratch/probe_depsrc.out.json): C:x, c:/lib.rs, a:b/c, Z:, a//b, a/ are admitted by the owner schema and mint a file-manifest identity but are refused by the candidate's canonical-path-segments. Snapshot paths are protected upstream (c2-plan-stage-schema.v3 canonicalRelativePath forbids drive prefix); dependency files (git/imported-descriptor/vendored trees) are not. A top-level file named e.g. 'a:b' is a legal POSIX name.

Frame capacity: DependencySourceManifest is one frame. Encoded entry is >=116 bytes (packageKey 'a 1 ', 1-byte path) and ~204 bytes for a realistic crates.io key and 24-byte path; the manifest exceeds maxFramePayloadBytes 67108864 above 578,523 (minimal) or ~328,964 (realistic) entries, while owner maxItems and ProtocolLimitsV3.maxDependencySourceEntries are 1,000,000. DEPSRC-CUSTODY states entries <= maxDependencySourceEntries only; no rule mentions maxFramePayloadBytes for dependency sources.

Aggregate request limits are unaddressed: maxRequestPayloadBytesTotal 9663676416 (rust2, retained) versus maxSnapshotTotalFileBytes 8 GiB + maxDependencySourceTotalBytes 8 GiB + maxPreparedOutputTotalBlobBytes 1 GiB, and maxRequestFrames 1,000,000 versus 1,000,000 dependency entries plus snapshot frames; no candidate rule states their fate.
NFC: DEPSRC-SET-KEY-CONSTRAINTS admits a set whose sourceId is non-NFC ('e\u0301') while the wire Rust3PackageKey refuses NON_NFC; owner DependencyPackageSourceV1 fields do not require NFC.

These all become a host that cannot lawfully encode, or a worker FRAME-LIMIT/lexical refusal, i.e. operational-failed PROVIDER.PROTOCOL_VIOLATION (or a host invariant) for a reachable input - the misclassification review-01 RF-3 rejected for prepared outputs. The candidate newly applied canonical-path-segments to dependency paths, so the narrowing is its own.
requiredFindings.fix: Add a DEPSRC wire-representability rule applied at dependency-source set admission or at the latest before spawn: refuse a path failing canonical-path-segments, a non-NFC name/version/sourceId/path, an encoded DependencySourceManifest over maxFramePayloadBytes, and state the fate of aggregate request bytes/frames against maxRequestPayloadBytesTotal/maxRequestFrames (refusal or an explicit root decision).
